purpose: Offer a small compiler from independently approved core/per-feature allowances to existing shared raw-time case rows, retaining exact mode selection and truthful feature-activity witnesses.
first_step: Read #68 and current #64. Run python -m unittest discover -s .reference -v, including the headroom counterexample. Decide the real authoritative declaration, reviewed binding extraction and feature verification before approving any concrete project limits.

checks.environment: Python 3.12.14; Linux x86_64; Git 2.56.1; PyYAML 6.0.3. Local reference tests, not an admitted GitHub Actions performance profile.
checks.notes: 7 focused tests passed. Uses the existing pinned all performance contracts.load_authority/evaluate API; exact envelopes/modes, zero versus inapplicable allowances, independently read synthetic file events, raw misses and pinned Git-object loading. The seven imported shared source files were checked against their Git blob identities at the base commit.

checks.command: Consumer numerical approval, actual feature-bound operation binding and admitted GitHub Actions timing
checks.reason: All numbers and admission/elapsed records in these tests are illustrative. No consumer budget, resource profile or production operation was qualified.

limitations: C+P/D/L rows are absolute complete-configuration envelopes, not measured marginal feature costs. A tested counterexample shows core headroom can hide feature work exceeding its nominal allowance. Honest independently attributable operations can receive separate approved caps; no noisy subtraction proves exact overhead.

require_selections and require_activity consume facts from a future reviewed real adapter/verifier. This reference does not discover bindings, establish event provenance/completeness or connect those predicates into the shared runner.
The compiler assumes all applicable features can be enabled together. A genuinely unsupported combination requires an owning decision and adaptation; no exhaustive configuration matrix is imposed.
Zero is an applicable no-added-headroom allowance; None is explicitly inapplicable. Example numbers are invented nanoseconds for arithmetic tests, never proposed consumer budgets.
Normal-operation resumability maintenance cannot qualify post-interruption recovery. That needs its own owning failure/completion contract and approved operation budget.

Declaration approval, derived-row agreement, protected workflow authority, true feature execution, full production completion and mandatory-guarantee classification remain real integration obligations.
No timer, calibration model, new runner, adaptive credit/debt framework or consumer-repository modification is introduced. The handling agent owns acceptance and its Proffer disposition.
